children: Azeri BTC crude oil exports from Turkey's Ceyhan port have been set at 15.7 million barrels in October compared with 15.1 million barrels in the September plan, the schedule seen by Reuters showed on Wednesday.
On a daily basis, Azeri BTC crude oil exports will rise by about 1% in October from September, Reuters calculations showed.
